entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I'm just so confused. I need to return something, but the website is a bit much for me. I think I have a jersey I need to send back.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Um, yes, it's sarah.jenkins@email.com. I ordered it a while ago and just got around to trying it on. It's just not right. Can't you just help me? I'm not very good with these things.
Of course, Sarah, I'm here to help. I see your account now. I'm showing an order for the Pro-Series Cycling Jersey, delivered about 54 days ago. Is that the one?
Yes, that's the one! It's the wrong size, I think. It's just too tight around the arms. I was hoping to do an exchange for a larger size, if possible.
Absolutely. Let me just check our policy. Okay, great news. For a standard item like that jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So what do I do?
I can set this up for you right now. I can either process a full refund to your original payment method, or we can start an exchange for the correct size. Which would you prefer?
An exchange would be wonderful, thank you! I'd like to try one size up.

Perfect. And Sarah, I see here that you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've waived the return shipping fee and I'm sending out the replacement jersey today with complimentary expedited shipping. You should receive a return label in your email within the next 15 minutes.
Wow, David, that's amazing! You've made this so easy. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
